title: Reachability in the converse digraph
statement: Let $D$ be a digraph with vertices $u$ and $v$, and let $\breve{D}$ denote its converse, the digraph obtained by reversing the orientation of every arc. Then $v$ is reachable from $u$ in $\breve{D}$ if and only if $u$ is reachable from $v$ in $D$.
hypotheses_covered: D is a digraph on a vertex type
u and v are vertices of D
replaced:
